JARVIS v19 - LOCAL AI AND NEURAL SPEECH

On this PC, Ollama, Qwen3 8B and the Kokoro speech model are installed.
On another PC, run Setup Local AI.cmd once, then Start Wallpaper.cmd.
Setup needs internet access to download Ollama, approximately 5.2 GB for Qwen3
8B, and approximately 326 MB for the neural voice model. Models are not in the ZIP.

Talk naturally: Jarvis, explain how black holes work.
Follow-ups can omit Jarvis for 90 seconds after a reply. Say stop conversation
to end follow-ups, or stop listening to turn the microphone listener off.
The tray voice menu can re-enable it. Windows English speech support is required.

Tray > AI conversation > Open conversation provides typed chat, full replies,
tool activity, source links, Stop response, and New conversation.
AI provider settings defaults to Local Ollama with qwen3:8b.
OpenAI is optional; it still needs its own key and API billing if selected.

LOCAL OPERATION
Language-model requests go to http://127.0.0.1:11434. No OpenAI key or balance is
needed in local mode. Ollama can be started automatically when a request needs it.
The model uses GPU/RAM and releases its loaded GPU allocation after idle timeout.
First load can take longer. Response speed depends on the PC and request.
Conversation context stays in memory, limited to six recent exchanges and a size
limit. New conversation or restarting clears it. Audio recordings are not saved.

WEB SEARCH
Web search sends the search query to Bing and retrieves result titles, snippets
and source links. It does not read full articles. It needs internet access and
may be unavailable if the search provider blocks the request. Disable web search
in AI provider settings for offline-only conversation and PC tools.
Ordinary local conversation and requested file contents are not sent to OpenAI.

PC TOOLS
Ask JARVIS to find files/folders, read requested text/code documents, or open apps,
files, folders and websites. It discovers apps through your configured aliases,
Start menu shortcuts and Windows App Paths. Existing local app commands remain.
Each filename search is limited to 10 seconds, 250000 entries or 40 results,
with partial-result reporting. Windows file permissions apply. Protected paths,
directory links and obvious credential files are skipped. Text reads return
at most 16000 characters. PDF/Office contents are not extracted, but those files
can be found and opened. Scripts, installers, destructive actions, arbitrary
commands and administrator operations are not AI tools in this release.

LESS ROBOTIC SPEECH
Tray > JARVIS voice > Response voice:
- British neural - George (default)
- British neural - Lewis
- British neural - Daniel
- Windows voices, retained as an option and fallback
Speech speed offers Measured 90%, Natural 100%, and Brisk 110%.
The neural voices run locally on the CPU. They are distinct synthetic voices
with a British assistant style, not an actor voice clone.
The speech model is stored at %LOCALAPPDATA%\HudWall\Models\kokoro.onnx.
Windows voice fallback is used if the model is missing or neural synthesis fails.
Use Test spoken response in the voice tray menu to preview the selected voice.

STARTUP AND MONITORS
Automatic Windows startup and existing appearance controls remain available.
Span HUD across all monitors combines the desktop into one stationary HUD.
The primary display supplies theme/transparency; any monitor pause rule pauses
the shared HUD. Turn spanning off to restore per-monitor settings.

VERIFIED ON THE CURRENT PC
Qwen3 8B ran with GPU acceleration on the RTX 5070 Ti. Live checks covered file
search/read, follow-up context, web sources, a controlled app launch, and British
neural speech generation. Other PC performance and model availability may differ.
